title: Spigadolce | Authentic Pugliese Cooking Experiences in London

hero.heading: Learn to Cook Authentic Pugliese Food in London
hero.subheading: Hands-on 3-hour classes: pasta, sauces and traditional dishes. In a warm, welcoming atmosphere or at our partner restaurants.

intro.text: Immerse yourself in the warmth and flavours of Pugliese cuisine. I'll guide you through authentic recipes — hand-shaped pasta, slow-simmered sauces and traditional dishes — and we'll sit down together to enjoy every bite, the way families in Puglia have done for generations.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.subheading: Three hours to learn, cook and share a complete Pugliese meal

steps.title: Knead
steps.description: Learn to make fresh pasta by hand using traditional Pugliese techniques — orecchiette, cavatelli, tagliatelle and more.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Prepare a traditional sauce and complete the dish. Every class includes a starter, a pasta course and a Pugliese sweet.

steps.title: Feast
steps.description: Sit down at the table and savour what you've created, with a glass of Pugliese wine. Take the recipe home with you.

home.description: Wimbledon, SW19 — A warm, intimate setting for up to 6 guests. Like stepping into the kitchen of a Pugliese family home.
